response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth, extensive tooling experience (test runners, CI/CD, DLang libraries), and clear leadership in open-source and workshops, but lacks explicit evidence of people management, team leadership, or mobile platform experience — key requirements for this Engineering Productivity Manager role.
strengths: Extensive experience building developer tools (test runners, CI/CD, code generators)
Proven track record of technical leadership through open-source projects and workshops
Strong cross-stack expertise with mobile (iOS/Apple TV), web, and embedded systems
concerns: No clear evidence of formal people management or team leadership experience
Limited documentation of mobile platform ecosystem experience beyond iOS app maintenance
No mention of strategic roadmap planning or organizational change leadership
